_comment: channel-types and communication-providers live in ../metadata-channel-optional/ (NOT this scanned tree) because they target the Channel Messages system (e.g. Izzy), which a standalone MJ+BizAppsCommon install does not have ('Channel Types' isn't a core MJ entity). The default app uses the owned SecureMessage store; the 'channel' adapter is opt-in. To install into a Channel host, sync those dirs separately.
